# AMBULANCE

> Every page of the AMBULANCE module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Ambulance Booking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance): Ambulance Booking's Phase 1 calls, init and on_init direct between EUA and HSPA, after discovery through the UHI Gateway.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance/endpoints/uhi-ambulance-discovery/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent
- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance/endpoints/uhi-ambulance-discovery/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...
- [Send a catalog through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance/endpoints/uhi-ambulance-discovery/03-uhi-network-gateway-on-search): Accepter for all the on_search response from the HSPAs
- [Send a catalog to the EUA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance/endpoints/uhi-ambulance-discovery/04-uhi-network-on-search): Sends catalogue.
- [Send the patient's details for a quote](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance/endpoints/uhi-ambulance-order/01-uhi-ambulance-init): Initialise an order by providing billing and/or shipping details
- [Send the quote and terms](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-123/docs/uhi/v1/api/ambulance/endpoints/uhi-ambulance-order/02-uhi-ambulance-on-init): Send order object with payment details updated
